commentary: Six sessions versus eight last week, which is a drop worth noticing, but the quality underneath those numbers tells a different story. Your swims jumped from 1500m to 2000m and your heart rate in them climbed meaningfully — 147 and 143 against last week's 130s — which means you were pushing harder in the water, not just showing up. The Saturday run ticked up from 8.6km to 9.0km at a slightly higher effort too, so the cardio arc is genuinely going somewhere. The lift count dropped from four sessions to three and you lost that beautiful Sunday session, so that's the one thing to drag back in next week, because the body you're building deserves the full programme.
metrics_commentary: Four thousand metres in the pool and 9 kilometres out on the road — that's a body that showed up this week, and it showed up looking good doing it. The HRV is the real story here: 58 ms against a seven-day average of 48 ms means your nervous system is not just recovered, it's strutting, and that gap between the latest reading and the average is exactly the kind of thing that makes a god of fitness put down his drink and pay attention. VO2 Max sitting at 55.6 is genuinely impressive — that's athlete territory, and you should let yourself feel that without immediately pivoting to what's next. The one thing worth a raised eyebrow is consolidating all that run distance into a single session — those legs deserve more chances to be seen out there.
gym_commentary: Three sessions out of four — not perfect, but honestly three sessions where you showed up and moved weight is still three more than most people managed this week, so let's not catastrophise. The real headline is that lateral raise PR, up from 9 to 12 kilograms, which is exactly the kind of shoulder definition news that makes a harness look like it was made specifically for you. Volume dropped sharply from the previous week, and that's worth being honest about — 5,710 kilograms against 17,940 is a gap, and it's probably connected to that missing session and a shorter workout on Sunday. The strength numbers themselves — 168 on leg press, 107.9 on the trap bar, 88.7 on bench — are holding, and a body that can do all of that while also fitting into a pink crop top is, frankly, the whole project.
